profiles.name: SDXL / descriptive baseline
profiles.note: Not a universal profile for every SDXL derivative. Character limits are Studio budgets.
profiles.summary: Write plain sentences. Good for photographic and illustrated stills with a negative prompt; it reads no reference images.

profiles.name: Animagine XL 4.0 / approved tags
profiles.note: Only reviewed tags are emitted; no invented score tags, artist identity or LoRA triggers. Compare Opt separately.
profiles.summary: Write comma-separated booru tags, not sentences. Nothing is translated into tags for you.

profiles.name: FLUX.2 / positive description
profiles.note: Text-only projection. Local Klein/dev and hosted pro/max have different execution contracts. No negative channel.
profiles.summary: Write plain sentences. FLUX has no negative prompt, so anything to avoid has to be said positively or kept as a review note.

profiles.name: Qwen Image Edit 2511 / 1–3 reference images
profiles.note: Scope is TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus three-slot graph. Reference map is data; actual uploads/node bindings are a separate stage.
profiles.summary: Attach one to three reference images and describe the change. Each picture gets a named role.

profiles.name: Wan 2.2 image-to-video / motion brief
profiles.note: I2V baseline only; preserve approved first frame. Duration and frame grid belong to the selected graph.
profiles.summary: Attach the approved first frame and describe the movement: subject, camera, and what stays fixed.

profiles.name: Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign / words and direction
profiles.note: Projection for generate_voice_design(text, instruct, language). Not a cloning or CustomVoice adapter.
profiles.summary: Exact words to speak stay byte-for-byte; performance direction is written separately.

profiles.name: ACE-Step 1.5 / caption, lyrics and metadata
profiles.note: GenerationParams field projection, not arbitrary REST payload. Executor must resolve model/task/codec and documented feature matrix.
profiles.summary: A caption describes the track; lyrics stay byte-for-byte. BPM, key and meter are separate fields.

profiles.name: Stable Audio Open / sound description
profiles.note: Prompt projection only; seconds_start/seconds_total and exact model variant need a validated execution adapter.
profiles.summary: One short description of the sound. No negative prompt, no lyrics, no reference images.

profiles.name: TRELLIS.2 / approved image input
profiles.note: No invented text-prompt field. Refine the input image first or route structural changes to Blender.
profiles.summary: Reads one approved image and no prompt text. Refine the image first, in an image recipe.
